item.name: Crippling Crossbow

effects.title: Hobble
effects.text: Hits an enemy for 25 damage, then slows them by 50% and reduces Health Restoration by 40% for 4 seconds. The slow gradually fades over the duration of the spell.

item.lore: The ever-weeping woodgrain of this crossbow coats every bolt in a potent but short-lived narcotic sap.
